environment_note: NOT run inside the image. The app is macOS-native and its command execution cannot be redirected: its execution-target selector offers only Local, Settings has no shell path, it does not honour SHELL (a wrapper that execs into the container returned Darwin 24.6.0 arm64 from inside the agent), and its only non-GUI entry point is a macOS arm64 binary. Ran in a clean directory holding only the 22 recordings, every clip verified against media_manifest.json.
